title: The Best Looks From Darren Dzienciol's Haunted Hotel Halloween Party in LA
excerpt: On Saturday night, Darren Dzenicol once again threw his highly anticipated annual Haunted Hotel Halloween party in Los Angeles presented by 1WIN with special guest host Vanessa Hudgens.
content:
Machine Gun Kelly and Darren Dzienciol (Getty Images)

On Saturday night, Darren Dzienicol once again threw his highly anticipated annual Haunted Hotel Halloween party in Los Angeles presented by 1WIN with special guest host Vanessa Hudgens.

Vanessa Hudgens (Getty Images)

VIP attendees included Vanessa Hudgens and husband Cole Tucker, Machine Gun Kelly, Alix Earle, Ashtin Earle, Landon Barker, Oliver Trevena, Ross Butler, Carter Gregory, Alex Consani, David Dobrik, Emma Pill, Josie Canseco, Will Peltz, Kenya Jones Peltz, Mike Majlak, N3on, Frankie Stark, King Bach, Dixie D’Amelio, Anastasia Karanikolaou, Corey Gamble, Jonatas Jacque, Connor Tracy, Dylan Minette, Darianka Sanchez, Darianka Sanchez, Laila Hasanovic, Yasmin Wiknaldun, Alejandra Polanco, and many more.

(Getty Images)

Guests entered tehe party through a dimly lit recreation of a 1940s-inspired hotel lobby and check-in, lined with candles, deep jewel toned floral arrangements, and adorned with spider webs. Rusty luggage carts pushed by creepy bellman lined the arrivals path, as guests entered the fully decked out Halloween night bash. The venue was incredibly transformed into an eerie Haunted Hotel, with skulls and bloody mirrors at every turn.

Partygoers danced the night away in the dark and mystifying atmosphere sipping on Halloween themed LALO Tequila cocktails paired with Caliwater cactus water, plus Tito’s Vodka, and flowing champagne, as DJ sets kicked off with Jack Henry, followed by Zack Bia, and DJ Cruz to close the affair. Around 1am, Machine Gun Kelly climbed on the fog filled stage to make a surprise performance.

Machine Gun Kelly (Getty Images)

Guests snacked on delectable burgers and fries from Butter Bun, passed around by gothic-inspired French maids. The theme was carried out in all elements, including the 1WIN Casino where partygoers could partake in casino games to win prizes throughout the night.
